Reference image 2 is an existing event illustration from this game: copy its ART STYLE (bold dark hand-drawn outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading, chunky cute chibi proportions) and the way the scene is cut out on a transparent background. The whole scene is centred with a clear transparent margin on every side; nothing is cut off at the edges.
